name: revise_skill
description: Stage a new version of a learned skill that observations show failing, corrected or incomplete. A suspended skill becomes active again.

name.description: Optional new slug, at most 64 characters.

description.description: Optional new one-line description, at most 200 characters.

body.description: Optional new Markdown without front matter, at most 8000 characters.

category.description: Optional lowercase slug, at most 32 characters.
